hard_fixes.fix: Root cause: the iter1 guard realpath'd member names before extractall, so a symlink member pointing outside followed by a file written through it passed the check (reproduced on Python <3.14 defaults). Replaced with scripts/safe_io.safe_extract_tar: lexical pre-check of names, symlink/hardlink targets and special files, then extractall(filter='data') which re-checks against the filesystem per member. Verified against linux-6.12.113.tar.xz: 92471/92471 entries, 62 symlinks.
Same root cause; replaced with safe_extract_tar(progress=...). Tarball cache path/URL now require a dotted numeric version.

--kernel is normalised to the constant KERNEL_MAPPINGS key (require_supported_kernel) at the workflow boundary, and the kernel.org-sourced target_version must be digits and dots before it is put in the URL path.

Real traversals closed: --specs/spec names (joined onto SPECS dir and rewritten) must be plain file names; gap-report file names used the unvalidated kernel argv; tarball/source paths used spec- or kernel.org-sourced versions; repo_dir that ensure_photon_repo may rmtree is confined to <repo_base>/<branch>. All CLI kernel lists (cli.parse_kernel_arg, generate_full_matrix --kernels) are allowlisted. 10 of these 19 cleared in Snyk; the 9 that remain are listed under accepted.
Wrapped tarfile.extractall in a TarSlip-guard loop: realpath each member against the extract root before extractall, raise RuntimeError on slip. Added 'import os'.
Same fix at L517 dominates the four other Snyk-flagged data-flow sinks; they were tainted-flow alerts pointing at the integrity-check and download call sites for the same downstream extract.
Replaced the bare tar.extract loop with a realpath-validated TarSlip guard before each tar.extract(member) call. Added 'import os'.
Wrapped kernel_version with re.escape() inside the fix_pattern f-string so CLI-supplied regex metacharacters cannot induce catastrophic backtracking.
Set csv.writer(..., quoting=csv.QUOTE_ALL) on the two writers in cve_matrix.py to defeat CSV-injection via cell content that starts with =, +, -, @.
